shortDescription: Stacked z-levels as ONE BIG MAP. Pass 41: cross-level hauling rebuilt on a ColumnStorage query engine (vanilla search per level - mod-safe, no swaps, no cache). Fixed the real medicine/food bug found via the new haul-decision diagnostic: ExportAllowed's native-need retention now applies to CONSTRUCTION materials only, so consumables (food/medicine) follow storage priority into the best stockpile instead of being pinned in place.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER 2026-07-25/26)
**isolated=true always.** Companions: **always include `astryl.ModernDevTools`**; **do NOT add Melee Animation** (no effect on logistics, just noise); add `Mehni.PickUpAndHaul` for bulk-haul. Build a fresh column via the "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement" debug action (pin may log "Could not find node..." at startup - run it manually). Diagnostic: **"AB: explain haul decision"** (ToolMap) - click an item, it logs the full haul decision.

## PASS 41 — COLUMN STORAGE INDEX (rebuild of cross-level hauling)
**CORE:** vanilla maintains per-map priority-sorted haul-destination lists, and `StoreUtility.TryFindBestBetterStorageFor(item, carrier:null, map, ...)` runs the full search with NO reachability/virtual-swap and IS Harmony-patched by LWM Deep Storage / Adaptive Storage Framework - so modded storage is honored for free and any level is queryable cheaply.
- **Phase 1 — `Source/Logistics/ColumnStorage.cs`:** `TryFindBetter(pawn, item, out map, cell, dest, tier)` runs the carrier-less vanilla search on every level, keeps the single best; returns a CROSS target only for a strictly-higher tier on another level (equal / own-level win ties). `BestTierInColumn` + `FirstHopToward`. No swaps, no cache, vanilla-parity perf. Decision is coarse; execution validates per hop.
- **Phase 2 — all decisions routed through it:** `CrossLevelHaul.TargetLevelFor` storage branch = ColumnStorage + FirstHopToward (replaced the up/down virtual-swap Check + coarse LevelAcceptsItem); satisfies strictly-better + best-of-up/down + multi-hop-upgrade in one call. `CrossLevelHaulJob.Build` relays a 2-gap target via `AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels`. All storage givers route far targets through Build (removed TryStartFarHaul). `CrossLevelHaulChain.OnArrive` uses ColumnStorage for its continue-decision. Fetch early-out fixed to scan in-storage upgrade candidates.
- **DIAGNOSTIC (pass 41) — `AB: explain haul decision`:** prints per-level vanilla search results, ColumnStorage decision, exportAllowed, firstHopToward, and TargetLevelFor (evaluated with a pawn ON the item's level). This is what found the consumable-pin bug below in one click.
- **FIX (consumable export pin, USER-REPORTED "medicine/food show no spot; chunks work"):** the diagnostic showed `ColumnStorage=cross to L-1 @Critical` but `exportAllowed=False` -> `TargetLevelFor=null`. `CrossLevelDemand.ExportAllowed` was retaining any item the level natively needs, incl. CONSUMABLES (food/medicine have a consumable requirement on any inhabited level), pinning them in place. Chunks have no requirement, hence the asymmetry. FIX: `ExportAllowed` now calls `PinnedByNativeNeed(map, t, constructionOnly: true)` - retains CONSTRUCTION materials only (they're pulled-and-held by blueprints -> real carousel risk); consumables are consumed on delivery (no carousel; DeliveredHere covers the brief just-delivered window) so they follow one-big-map storage priority into the best stockpile and consumers fetch cross-level. ExportAllowedForDemand unchanged.
- **Phase 3 (PENDING):** event-driven upgrade driving (storage-change-triggered re-check) to replace the fetch's bounded in-storage scan - the "no ceiling" scale requirement.
- **Phase 4 (PENDING):** work-migration reads ColumnStorage for cheap cross-level haul-work detection (work-priority perf).

## Locked decisions (unchanged doctrines, implemented via ColumnStorage)
Cap 3 levels. Cross-level storage move only for a STRICTLY-higher tier than best-local; equal never crosses; best-of-up/down; multi-hop = one-hop-then-relay (store here or set down + re-designate). Vanilla HAULABILITY PARITY: non-alwaysHaulable things (chunks) need Orders->Haul or in-storage; consumables (alwaysHaulable) auto-haul freely and now organize cross-level. Allow Tool Haul Urgently (ignorePins) bypasses. CONSTRUCTION materials retained on their needing level; consumables follow storage. COMBAT/FoW per pass 38/39. Soft-compat: foreign types never in a signature (CAI reflection-only). RE-ENTRANCY: coalesce nulls; no re-entrant TryTakeOrderedJob carrying an item.

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · mech charge · p33 see-below · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose · p40 chunk designation gate · p40 multi-hop relay UPWARD · p40 pull-side fetch (designated).

## Compat
Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream · **LWM Deep Storage + Adaptive Storage Framework (p41: honored via vanilla's patched storage search)** · DBH/VEF/Rimefeller · Odyssey · Misc. Robots · Allow Tool · CE (p38) · CAI 5000/Krkr.rule56 (p39) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. Modern Dev Tools (dev; known-issues.json).

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
**PASS 41 (TOP):**
- Consumable fix (current): loose/stored FOOD and MEDICINE with a Critical stockpile on another level -> now flows into it (was pinned). Re-run `AB: explain haul decision` -> exportAllowed should be True and TargetLevelFor non-null. Confirm items ACTUALLY MOVE.
- Downward relay: Normal sky -> Critical basement (chunks AND consumables), no stall/bounce. 1-hop + reverse. Regression: designated-chunk gate, stop-at-first-accepting, equal-tier no-cross, PUAH no loop.
- Modded storage: if LWM / Adaptive Storage added, confirm items flow into their containers across levels.

## Status
2026-07-26 (pass 41, BUILT GREEN 0/0): rebuilt cross-level hauling on `ColumnStorage` (mod-safe vanilla per-level search, no swaps/cache). Added `AB: explain haul decision` diagnostic which pinpointed the real medicine/food bug in one click: `ExportAllowed`'s native-need retention was pinning CONSUMABLES in place (chunks unaffected -> the reported asymmetry). Fixed: retention is now CONSTRUCTION-only; consumables follow storage priority into the best stockpile. Phases 3 (event-driven upgrade at scale) + 4 (work-migration perf) still pending. Testing ISOLATED + Modern Dev Tools + PUAH.
